scope: All 13 original issues and original PRs; preserve every original acceptance criterion
evidence_scope: Interim requirement -> expected event -> implementation -> test -> runtime report map. Original criteria preserved; not a final criterion-by-criterion completion claim. Reports retain immutable runtime source versions and controlled-vs-real boundaries.

original_acceptance_criteria: Production-like tests document practical limits and failure behavior for the current single-user workload.
Repository APIs accept domain IDs and hide `record_id` resolution.
Ambiguous create cases use business-key reconciliation rather than blind POST retry.
Feishu implementation can be replaced behind the provider contract without changing core domain logic.
No second primary database is added unless feasibility tests demonstrate a concrete requirement.

entries.evidence_boundary: 真实应用 CRUD/批读；v3 部分为用户身份；模糊写入故障为受控传输
entries.remaining_or_limits: 平台极限和生产 ACL 不作保证；保留单 writer；全项目覆盖率尚缺

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Domain-ID/record-ID mismatch tests cover read/update/delete, completion/failure, and rollback; missing/duplicate business keys fail explicitly.
A create committed remotely before a simulated timeout is reconciled without a second blind POST.
Record measured CRUD/PATCH availability, pagination, batch behavior, history, rate/conflict handling, payload limits, and recovery for representative v0.2 records.
Add transport/provider contract tests and a clearly gated live feasibility suite; distinguish mocks, skipped live checks, and measured results.
Document additive schema rollout/backfill/rollback and legacy snapshot compatibility without introducing a second primary database.

original_acceptance_criteria: Runnable-step selection has one authoritative code path.
State changes cannot bypass the state-transition service in new code.
Single-backend execution works without distributed-worker assumptions.
Retry/recovery behavior is covered by tests for process restart, tool failure, and ambiguous persistence outcomes.
Architecture docs and code-level contracts agree on the execution model.
entries.expected_event: 唯一内核按显式状态机调度、重启/审批恢复；慢 handler 期间仍能观察已提交进度

entries.remaining_or_limits: 原始 FeishuAPIError 的远程原因仍未确认；残留追踪已在原 PR #25 同日修复，不能由此推断原始故障原因

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Starting the documented service runs an enqueued deterministic mock/tool workflow without manual `poll_once` calls; shutdown stops cleanly.
Concurrent API actions and scheduler ticks use one writer and enforce valid transitions; approvals are idempotent and version-aware.
Restart before/after persistence, partial run creation, exhausted retries, and tool failures recover or stop with explicit state.
With domain IDs different from Feishu record IDs, all pipeline/step read/update/rollback paths target the correct records.
Integration tests exercise the real composition boundary, not only repositories replaced by permissive mocks.

original_acceptance_criteria: At least DeepSeek and OpenAI can be represented behind the same model-provider contract even if only one is configured in local development.
Every new generated artifact is versioned and traceable to its inputs/model/prompt version.
Cost/usage metadata can be queried per run and per chapter.
Evals can compare two prompt/model/workflow variants using the same fixtures.
New Agent roles or additional model passes require an eval-backed quality/cost justification.
entries.expected_event: 生成 Artifact 可追溯，统一路由记录实际模型/usage，允许固定 fixture 比较方案
entries.evidence_boundary: 真实 DeepSeek 与飞书；当前保留 100 个 Artifact 内容哈希独立重算一致；OpenAI 为传输契约
entries.remaining_or_limits: 直接模型产物已绑定确认的 trace ID，断链精确重放无重复调用；旧记录未猜测回填；全 app 四项 100% 与最终逐条件核验继续

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: DeepSeek and OpenAI adapters satisfy one contract, including valid output, schema failure, provider failure, retry, and missing configuration.
Artifact metadata records immutable version/source/hash/run/prompt references and survives retry without accidental overwrite.
Usage queries aggregate attempts per run and chapter; mark estimated or unavailable costs explicitly rather than treating missing usage as zero.
Fixed fixtures compare at least two route/prompt/workflow configurations with machine-readable quality/cost/latency results.
Trace APIs expose deterministic tool calls and model calls with failure classes and correlation IDs; sensitive credentials are excluded.

original_acceptance_criteria: A workflow can fetch 30–50 public Douyin hotspot records.
Normalized records are persisted to Feishu with source, business ID, dedupe hash, status, and capture metadata.
Duplicate records are reconciled rather than blindly re-created.
Tool/schema failures are observable through StepRuns and traces.
Collection and normalization do not require an LLM call.
entries.expected_event: 公开 50 条完成入库；同一已保存批次逐条对账，既有记录不重建
entries.evidence_boundary: 真实匿名采集一次；真实应用持久化；已保存批次重放 50 reconciled、0 新增/更新，403 记录不变
entries.remaining_or_limits: 工具/模式/模糊网络故障为受控测试；更晚真实捕获的元数据更新尚未实测

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Replaying the same batch, including after a restart or a committed-but-timed-out create, produces no duplicate hotspots.
Inject timeout, nonzero exit, invalid JSON, malformed records, and storage failure; StepRun/trace exposes the outcome and recovery is bounded.
A controlled 30–50-record fixture exercises fetch → normalization → persistence → API read. A live source returning fewer records is reported accurately rather than padded.
Report fetched/accepted/rejected/deduplicated counts and keep source provenance; repeated requests use stable business keys.

original_acceptance_criteria: User can view Feishu-backed hotspot records through backend APIs.
User can trigger the hotspot workflow from the UI.
User can discard or manually add a hotspot.
The page is workflow/content-centric and does not expose implementation-specific Agent controls as the primary UX.
entries.expected_event: 用户筛选/详情/分页和触发采集可观察真实结果，未知结果可精确重放
entries.evidence_boundary: 真实浏览器到飞书 50 条；桌面/390px 详情与分页通过；手动/丢弃恢复另有受控端到端
entries.remaining_or_limits: 十秒提交超时仍可能发生，当前按保留命令恢复；不重新写真实公开数据来重复演示丢弃

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Empty, loading, filtered, failed, and successful views behave correctly using actual backend payloads.
Manual add/discard persist through the backend and are reflected after refresh; repeated clicks do not create duplicate work.
Fetch/analyze shows a run ID, changing status, and actionable failure details.
Protected operations use the existing session/proxy flow; backend/provider credentials never enter browser configuration.

original_acceptance_criteria: Given a hotspot, the workflow produces a structured opportunity artifact with required fields.
Invalid model output is rejected or repaired before persistence.
High-risk or ambiguous items are routed to human review; routine low-risk outputs continue automatically.
Every run records input refs, output refs, model route, latency, usage, and failure class.
entries.expected_event: 热点产生结构化机会 Artifact，风险/选择门控制推进，失败明确可查
entries.evidence_boundary: 保留的真实 DeepSeek/飞书机会和 risk/risk_review；真实 risk_gate 与 selection 已批准
entries.remaining_or_limits: 低风险自动继续与坏输出验证有受控测试，未把它们称为重复真实质量统计

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Fixture-driven valid, invalid, high-risk, and ambiguous model outputs exercise validation, bounded repair, failure recording, and approval routing.
Repeated execution retains source-hotspot references and creates deliberate artifact versions without duplicate approval events.
Model/provider failures are traceable and cannot silently advance the workflow.
A selected hotspot can be analyzed through the authenticated API and returned to the product screen.

original_acceptance_criteria: An approved opportunity can produce at least 10 title candidates.
A selected title can produce at least 3 cover directions.
Outputs include source refs, model/prompt version, content hash, and usage metadata.
Invalid or duplicate outputs are rejected before human review.
Results are visible and selectable from the product UI.
entries.expected_event: 已批准机会生成至少 10 标题、选定标题生成至少 3 封面方向
entries.evidence_boundary: 当前保留真实 20 TitleCandidate、5 CoverPlan；对应两流程 completed、选择门 success
entries.remaining_or_limits: 标题市场效果/长期模型质量不由数量或 schema 保证；去重/错误为受控测试

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Validate at least 10 distinct title candidates and at least 3 cover directions for a selected title, with bounded handling of insufficient/invalid model output.
Re-generation preserves prior versions and their approval decisions.
Stale or rejected source artifacts cannot unblock book bootstrap.
Backend responses expose stable business IDs, source versions, and trace references required by the UI.

original_acceptance_criteria: Approved opportunity unblocks title/cover workflow.
Selected title/cover unblocks book bootstrap.
Human actions create `ApprovalEvent` records through backend APIs.
UI focuses on decisions and content rather than exposing internal Agent mechanics.
entries.expected_event: 人类对机会/标题/封面做版本化决定，保存 ApprovalEvent 并解锁后续
entries.evidence_boundary: 真实批准和已选来源解锁现存 Book；未知响应/精确重放有真实与受控证据，边界见原报告
entries.remaining_or_limits: 变更选择/失败存储覆盖按各报告 source；未把每种 UI 错误都当真实飞书故障

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: End-to-end opportunity approval unlocks generation, and selecting eligible title/cover versions enables bootstrap.
Repeated submission is idempotent; stale-version/conflicting decisions are rejected and explained.
Loading, empty, authentication failure, backend failure, and regeneration states are visible.
Content comparison and decisions are primary; model/trace details are secondary.

original_acceptance_criteria: Approved inputs can bootstrap a Book and `StoryState v1`.
StoryState has explicit version, content hash, source refs, and timestamps.
Agent/runtime code reads canonical StoryState through a context/provider boundary.
Frontend can display core book/story state without an Agent-centric panel.

entries.evidence_boundary: 当前真实 ready Book，保留 StoryState v1/v2 和源 refs；恢复/外部变化有受控 E2E
entries.remaining_or_limits: 不创建独立记忆 Agent；当前运行仍依赖完整 Base schema 和单 writer

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Repeated bootstrap or an interrupted create recovers one Book and one intended initial state version through a stable business key.
Reject missing/stale/unapproved inputs before committing canonical state.
Book and StoryState can be read by business IDs and displayed with source/version references.
Failed partial initialization is reconciled without silently losing provenance or overwriting historical state.

original_acceptance_criteria: All current routes share the design system at desktop and mobile widths; mobile keeps status and light approval practical without horizontal overflow.
Hover/tap/focus feedback and small transitions clarify actions, with reduced-motion support.
Text contrast, semantic structure, keyboard access, and touch target sizing remain usable.
Browser checks exercise the core hotspot → approval → book path on desktop and mobile.
One issue-specific PR links this Linear issue and its GitHub counterpart, with screenshots and test evidence.

ChapterBrief includes opening hook, scene goal, conflict, payoff, ending hook, and source version refs.
Approved or policy-eligible briefs unblock chapter generation.
StoryState changes are structured, validated, versioned, and traceable.

Initial Bible and major direction changes wait for approval; policy-eligible routine briefs proceed.
Every brief and snapshot can resolve the exact input state/artifact versions after later state changes.

original_acceptance_criteria: A Book can generate the first 1–3 chapter versions from approved/policy-eligible briefs.
Every ChapterVersion links to the StoryContextSnapshot and source Artifact versions used.
Critique is structured and actionable rather than another unconditional full rewrite.
Deterministic failures prevent persistence/finalization where applicable.
Model calls record route, prompt version, token usage, estimated cost, latency, and retries.
The old unconditional `Writer → StyleAgent → AntiAIFlavorAgent → ReviewAgent` chain is not used.

github_additional_acceptance_checks.requirement: Generate 1–3 chapters with exact snapshot/source version provenance and per-chapter usage accounting.
Cover pass-without-rewrite, revise, reject, hard-rule failure, provider failure, and rewrite-budget exhaustion.

Restart/retry cannot duplicate the same intended output version or bypass a required human gate.

original_acceptance_criteria: User can approve/finalize or return a chapter through backend APIs.
RevisionTask is created with explicit constraints and source version.

UI is book/chapter-centric rather than Agent-centric.
